title: Fourth-Moment Geometry of Rademacher Sums
abstract: arXiv:2608.17802v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Let $\varepsilon_1,\ldots,\varepsilon_n$ be independent Rademacher signs and let $a=(a_1,\ldots,a_n)\in\R^n$ satisfy the normalization below. For the normalized Rademacher sum, we determine how its higher moments depend on the fourth-order mass. Combining a sharp fixed-q moment envelope with a separate argument below the convexity threshold gives the Gaussian stability inequality for the full range $p\geq4$ of this linear-in-q bound. The same fourth-order framework determines the sharp finite dimensional $L_p/L_4$ Khintchine constant for $p\geq5$, with the flat coefficient vector as the extremizer. These results settle the conjectures of Jakimiuk and of Bara\'nski, Murawski, Nayar, and Oleszkiewicz stated below. We also prove Jakimiuk's conjectured quadratic stability estimate at $p=3$. The resulting bounds retain information about sparsity and effective dimension, with applications to Rademacher random projections and randomly signed er

translated_title: 拉德马赫和的四阶矩几何
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17802v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：设$\varepsilon_1,\ldots,\varepsilon_n$为独立的拉德马赫符号，且$a=(a_1,\ldots,a_n)\in\R^n$满足下述归一化条件。对于归一化的拉德马赫和，我们确定了其高阶矩如何依赖于四阶质量。将尖锐的固定q矩包络与凸性阈值以下的独立论证相结合，得到了全范围$p\geq4$下线性q界的高斯稳定性不等式。同一四阶框架确定了$p\geq5$时尖锐的有限维$L_p/L_4$ Khintchine常数，其中平坦系数向量为极值点。这些结果解决了Jakimiuk以及Barański、Murawski、Nayar和Oleszkiewicz在下文提出的猜想。我们还证明了Jakimiuk在$p=3$时猜想的二次稳定性估计。所得界保留了关于稀疏性和有效维度的信息，并应用于拉德马赫随机投影和随机符号擦除。
tldr: 本文通过四阶矩几何框架，解决了拉德马赫和的高阶矩依赖问题，证明了高斯稳定性不等式和Khintchine常数的尖锐界，并验证了多个猜想。
en_tdlr: This paper resolves the higher-moment dependence of Rademacher sums via fourth-order geometry, proving sharp Gaussian stability inequalities and Khintchine constants, and confirming several conjectures.
